verdicts.reason: A is the weaker resize. Its CTA comes first, at the far left and pressed against the edge, so the order runs backwards (action before headline). The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline. The flavour pills are reversed, the subcopy is squeezed into a two-line fragment beside them, and the legal text floats alone on the right with a large dead area. B keeps the CTA on the right, so it reads correctly left to right, but it is still flawed: the wordmark sits under the headline, the pills are reversed, the legal text is jammed against the pills at nearly body size, the vertical stack is cramped against the top and bottom edges, and the left circle leaves an empty block.
